AARON ALDERMAN / A CONVICTION & AN INVITATION

PowerAI must
serve life.

I believe we can build a civilisation in which growing intelligence gives people greater freedom to live, understand, create, and care.

A commitment to follow Jesus. A programme of scientific inquiry and working systems. An invitation to examine what their success could make possible.

THE AMBITION

That ambition reaches into science, technology, economics, politics, law, faith, education, work, and play—because these shape the possibilities of our lives together.

My starting conviction is to follow Jesus: power finds its purpose in love and service. I am giving that conviction practical form through mathematical inquiry, working software, and systems designed to make intelligence accountable to the people it serves.

The work has begun. Its civilisational promise remains to be earned.

WHAT IT COULD MEAN FOR YOU

For you, that promise could mean help with burdens you want to put down. The ability to create something you could not create alone. Tools you can understand and shape. Knowledge, skills, and capabilities that remain yours. A meaningful say in decisions that affect your life—and a place in building what comes next.

If this programme succeeds, it could change what we reasonably expect from power. It could make a more humane future something people know how to work toward, with routes they can follow and contributions they can make.

There is something worth building, and you can have a real place in building it.

Read the vision, examine the work, question its claims, and decide what it could mean for your life.
